# Contract: long-form-storyboard

Third-party skill from [genfeedai/skills](https://github.com/genfeedai/skills) (MIT, Genfeed.ai), `b5f8c25`. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Long-form script, sections, and a shot list before recording). The method is upstream. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Turn a transcript or idea dump into a long-form plan: spoken narration, sections, and a shot list with one cutaway brief per beat.

## Use it for
- "storyboard this long video"
- "turn this transcript into a shot list"

## Not for
- a short sayable script (video-script)
- cutting footage that already exists (rough-cut or vlog-auto-edit)

## Accepted inputs
A transcript, notes, or an idea dump. Bun 1.1+ runs the checker. ffprobe is used only to read a recording's length.

## Deliverables
storyboard.json, narration script, shot-list.md, captions sidecar, and an assembly manifest once media exists.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Bun 1.1+ (the long-form-storyboard checker; https://bun.sh)

Optional:
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
The checker is local and makes no network call. Hosted avatar or voice renders are out of scope.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None for the local plan. Picture generation, if the user does it, is their own tool.

## Workflow
1. Get the material
2. Find the spine
3. Write the narration for the ear
4. Brief one cutaway per beat
5. Validate
6. Get the plan approved
7. Make the pictures
8. Record
9. Compile
10. Assemble and check
11. Package and post

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- The one promise of the video
- Approve the plan before recording or making pictures

## Quality checks
- bun run scripts/storyboard.ts validate on the storyboard
- Every claim in the narration came from the user's material

## Common failures
- Timing is proportional to word count unless start and end are supplied
- Assembly of the final picture needs ffmpeg and is not this script

## Limitations
- Upstream tested the checker with synthetic media, not a real voice note
- Not run here
